title: Brainstorm birthday gift ideas for a hard‑to‑shop‑for relative with Meta AI
facebook: Ever stare at a store or gift registry with no clue what to get someone? Meta AI can take a simple description of that hard-to-shop-for person and turn it into ten actual, buyable ideas in about ten minutes. Here's how to do it.
